review:
Train to Rio Grande is a 10-line western slot with a simple bonus structure. Three, four or five bonus symbols trigger the bonus game, and the number matters: four symbols add a 3x multiplier to your wins, and five add 10x.

The bonus can be bought where permitted, with the price adjusting to your stake. BGaming rates the game very high volatility with a maximum multiplier of 10,490x, the same structure and ceiling as Wild Cash x9990 with a different theme. The RTP is 96.1%. As with that game, most of the potential sits in rare five-symbol triggers, so expect big swings.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
